title: Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge Matching
tldr_zh: 提出 IMF：交替 Markov/reciprocal 投影求 SB，双向 bridge matching 实现（DSBM），每轮保两端边缘
tldr_en: Iterative Markovian Fitting alternates Markovian and reciprocal projections to reach the SB; DSBM implements it with forward/backward bridge matching, preserving both marginals.
